18 U.S.C. §2258A
18 U.S.C. §2258A is a US legislation imposing mandatory reporting obligations for child sexual abuse content.

NCMEC
The National Center for Missing & Exploited Children (NCMEC) is responsible for receiving reports of child sexual abuse content as mandated by law.

US
US refers to the geographical region affected by the described regulations and features.

Chat UI Overhaul
The Chat UI Overhaul refers to a newly tested chat layout aimed at improving user experience in specific regions.

ShadowMode
ShadowMode is a feature that allows for analytics collection in a non-user-impacting manner to gather usage metrics.

Brazil
Brazil is one of the geographical regions where the new chat layout will be tested.

Geo-handler (GH)
Geo-handler (GH) is a module responsible for routing features based on user regions to ensure compliance with varying regulations.

Indonesia
Indonesia is one of the geographical regions where the new chat layout will be tested.

Child Sexual Abuse Content
Child Sexual Abuse Content refers to illegal materials that exploit or abuse minors, which providers are mandated to report under US law.

CyberTipline
CyberTipline is a reporting service operated by NCMEC for receiving reports related to child sexual abuse content.

Provider
Provider refers to an entity that offers services and is required to comply with reporting obligations under 18 U.S.C. §2258A regarding child sexual abuse content.

Canada
Canada is one of the geographical regions where the new chat layout will be tested.
